title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E01 — Roadside Murder
Theresa Wesolowski, 22, is murdered on May 29, 1999; police are baffled for nearly 10 years before finally getting a break when a new DNA technique identifies Wesolowski's coworker, Mark Libecki, as her killer.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S06 E04 — The Bad Apple
Francis Nicky Nicolosi and his devout new wife, Ellie, are living out the perfect retirement, then one of them is found dead in an apple orchard; police discover there's more to this seemingly frail and religious couple than anyone imagined.

title: Fatal Vows
description:

When Opal Skidmore marries Steven Williams, their love is a second chance for the pair to live out their dreams; soon, boredom and the lure of the open road spark hidden desires and sexual hijinks, leaving this open marriage anything but happy.

title: Fatal Vows
description:

Nurses Lara Crockett and Ricardo Muscolino meet on the night shift; he sets about creating a rich life for them, and she's happy to go along with it; Ricardo's scheming eventually drives Lara into the arms of another man with explosive results.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S06 E07 — Murder, Modesty, and the Pastor
Corinne Stoudt gets a second chance at love with husband Calvin, then a too-close roommate and a monstrous past turn this second chance into a deadly battleground.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E01 — Highway of Horrors
In 1992, a college student disappears after her car breaks down on the highway; family and friends join police in a frantic search that hits one setback after another; it may take new advances in DNA technology to finally crack this stubborn case.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

In 2001, actor Robert Blake finds his new wife, Bonny Lee Bakley, shot in the head in the couple's car; the largest homicide investigation in LAPD history uncovers a story of blind ambition and betrayal.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

title: People Magazine Investigates

Michelle Kinney is found murdered in her apartment in Dubuque, Iowa, puzzling her neighbors; local detectives unearth a haunting truth, leading to a shocking confession from an unlikely murderer.

When the battered body of Bianca Rainer, mother of two young girls, is found in rural Arkansas, the police have just one unusual clue, a puzzle piece found stuck to her body, but they know if they find the missing puzzle, they will find her murderer.

title: The Murder Tapes

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E03 — Room 48
In 2018, three women held hostage in a motel room by armed men face a night of terror that leaves 19-year-old Amber Meadows lying dead in the bathroom; detectives must follow a trail of surveillance footage to find out who pulled the trigger.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E01 — Fallen Star
In 2021, talented high school football star KJ Taylor is killed during a drive-by shooting outside a West Virginia convenience store; CCTV helps detectives follow the trail of the truck spotted stalking KJ's friends leading up to the shooting.

title: See No Evil
description:

In 2016, in Kamloops, Canada, a motel cleaner finds the body of an unidentified woman in one of the rooms; detectives turn to surveillance cameras to track a mysterious suspect in a cowboy hat, leading to a desperate manhunt across Canada.

title: See No Evil
description:

title: See No Evil

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E04 — He Didn't Know I Was There
A gunman shoots a man dead as he runs along a country road, and first responders find a witness standing next to the body with a strange story to tell; detectives unravel the lies of a callous psychopath who takes out his frustrations in bloodshed.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E01 — Something a Man Would Do
A woman finds her elderly brother dead in his bedroom with his throat slashed; uncovering the truth poses a challenge for detectives, as the individual responsible for killing him is a manipulative psychopath who craftily deflects blame.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E07 — Kids Will Be Kids
Police find a 17-year-old female's dead body in a ditch with two gunshot wounds; the investigation centers on two friends of the victim claiming her death was an accident, but detectives uncover it was a thrill kill carried out by evil psychopaths.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E03 — Having Breakfast on Him
Investigators search a farm for a missing man and find a human leg bone on the property; the owner, Susan Monica, admits that her pigs ate her tenant alive, and he's not the only victim; Monica despises humans but loves her pigs.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E07 — I'm Gonna Recycle a Snitch
Behind a church lies a dismembered body burned beyond recognition; investigators identify the victim and receive a tip the suspect is female; a police interview reveals her as the most remorseless psychopathic killer they've ever seen.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E05 — He Thought We Were Buddies
A man calls 911 with his dying breath, and first responders arrive to find him brutally murdered and stabbed 59 times; when detectives question his best friend, they uncover a tangled story of deception and jealousy that ends in psychopathic rage.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

Ainjil thinks William was charming and creative, but with time, his dark and violent tendencies emerge; when Ainjil finally gets away from him and starts a new life with a man she truly loves, he exacts revenge.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S14 E06 — She Knew It Was Goodbye
Ginger knows her sister Paige is trouble, as she feels entitled to her family's undivided attention and becomes a monster when she doesn't get it; over time, Ginger watches as Paige abuses and ultimately murders the person she cares for the most.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

title: Evil Lives Here

When Terry Patzer hears what police discovered at Russell Tillis' house of horrors, memories of the nine years she spent married to him come flooding back; she cannot explain how her former lover became so twisted.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S15 E04 — He Brought Roses and a Gun
Andrea believes that Ray Clark is the man of her dreams; but when she reveals she's pregnant, Ray becomes a nightmare; he stalks her and tortures their infant son; Andrea and her baby narrowly escape, but the next woman Ray meets isn't so lucky.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S13 E09 — Ménage à Terror
Genie already knows Lee Cawthon is capable of horrible things when he forces her into a polygamous relationship; she plays along with his twisted demands, but doesn't realize that the consequences of letting him have his way might be worse.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S19 E08 — I Still Hear Their Screams
When Felisha meets Wesley, she is a single mom with no place to live; he gives her a home, but after they are married and have kids, she discovers he is selfish and unkind. When she finally leaves him, he exacts the cruelest revenge.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E18 — Evilness Inside My Head
An emotional 911 call comes in from a young man claiming he just found his mother and dog murdered in their home; once his interview with detectives begins, they uncover a parasitic psychopath who will do anything to get away with the crime.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E19 — That's When My Nightmare Started
A small SD card contains horrifying images and videos of a woman's murder; when someone gives it to Anchorage police, detectives come face-to-face with a sexual psychopath who has a shocking tale to tell.
